Primary_Cause: PV module operating within nominal nominal operating cell temperature (NOCT) parameters.
Recommended_Action: No corrective maintenance required. Maintain regular quarterly thermographic and visual flyover inspection schedule.

Primary_Cause: Localized cell internal short-circuit or microcrack causing reverse bias heating.
Recommended_Action: Immediate thermal audit. Disconnect string from combiner box if Delta-T > 25°C. Check bypass diodes with forward-bias multimeter. Replace module if cell shunting is irreparable.

Primary_Cause: Mechanical stress from heavy wind loads, hailstorms, or improper foot traffic during installation.
Recommended_Action: Perform Electroluminescence (EL) imaging to check crack branch continuity. Monitor localized temperature for hot spot initiation. Seal with anti-degradation laminate or plan module replacement in next scheduled overhaul.

Primary_Cause: Atmospheric particulate deposition, desert dust, pollen, agricultural dust, or vehicular exhaust accumulation.
Recommended_Action: Deploy automated or semi-automated cleaning robots with demineralized water and soft rotating brushes. Avoid abrasive chemicals and daytime thermal shock washing.

Primary_Cause: Avian activity on array perimeters or absence of bird deterrent spikes/wires on PV mounting racks.
Recommended_Action: Targeted spot cleaning using biodegradable non-abrasive detergent and microfiber wipe. Install bird deterrent spikes or ultrasonic repellers on array mounting perimeters.

Primary_Cause: Severe hail strike, projectile impact, vandalism, or structural collapse of mounting tracker.
Recommended_Action: De-energize module string immediately! Lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures. Safely remove shattered panel wearing personal protective equipment (PPE). Replace with matching IV-curve rated module.

Primary_Cause: Ethylene Vinyl Acetate (EVA) encapsulant browning caused by UV exposure, high humidity, and poor additive formulation.
Recommended_Action: Measure IV-curve fill factor to evaluate resistance changes. Conduct EL inspection to map microcrack root causes. Log degradation rate into predictive maintenance registry.

Primary_Cause: Silicon ingot crystal impurities, wafer dislocation clusters, or metallization peel-off.
Recommended_Action: Perform anti-PID voltage reversal during nighttime if PID suspected. If crystallographic dead cell, replace bypass diode or bypass panel.

Primary_Cause: Vegetation overgrowth (trees, weeds), nearby structures, overhead transmission lines, or inter-row tracker shading.
Recommended_Action: Trim surrounding vegetation. Re-calibrate tracker azimuth and tilt angles. Consider Module-Level Power Electronics (MLPE) such as DC optimizers to mitigate mismatch.

Primary_Cause: Failed or shorted bypass diode in junction box.
Recommended_Action: Perform open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc) string test. Open junction box (when de-energized) to check diode integrity with DMM. Inspect MC4 connectors with thermal camera.
